def transform(row):
    codes = row["issue_codes"] or ""
    issues = row["specific_issues"] or ""
    names_venezuela = "venezuela" in codes.lower() or "venezuela" in issues.lower()
    if names_venezuela:
        basis = "issue text"
    elif row["exception_reason"]:
        basis = "reporter exception"
    else:
        basis = None
    return dict(row, inclusion_basis=basis)
